extDescription.message: Stop YouTube from refreshing your home feed when returning from a video. Features IndexedDB feed locking, accidental refresh undo, scroll anchoring, neighboring unwatched shelf, and local snapshots.

cmdToggleDrawer.message: Toggle TideLock Snapshots & Pinned Drawer on YouTube

sectionBesideLast.message: Right beside what you just watched

settingEnabledDesc.message: Restore the exact Home feed when returning from a video without opening extra tabs.

settingLogoPreserve.message: Keep feed when clicking YouTube logo from a video

settingLogoPreserveDesc.message: Clicking the logo while already on Home still loads a fresh feed.

settingRestoreScrollDesc.message: Stabilized scroll anchoring that yields immediately when you scroll.

settingMultiFeedDesc.message: Remember scroll position and watched cards on Subscriptions and Search results.

settingMarkWatched.message: Mark videos watched in this session

settingMarkWatchedDesc.message: Subtle badge on opened cards so nearby unwatched videos stand out.

settingHideShorts.message: Hide Shorts in Snapshots by default

settingHideShortsDesc.message: Keep snapshot & neighbor lists focused on full videos (toggleable anytime in the filter bar).

settingShowDock.message: Show compact floating dock on YouTube

settingShowDockDesc.message: Ideal for YouTube desktop PWA windows without a browser toolbar (Alt+Shift+T).

settingShowToastDesc.message: Brief pill with a one-click Refresh button when your feed is preserved.

emptySnapshots.message: Visit YouTube Home and TideLock will automatically snapshot your feed.

emptyPinned.message: No pinned videos yet. Hover any video card, right-click any YouTube link, or pin from Snapshots.
